name: use-platform
title: usePlatform
description: SSR-safe platform detection — { os, isTouch } from navigator.userAgentData with a navigator.platform fallback, corrected after hydration with no mismatch warning.

meta.whenToUse: Any copy or control that branches on modifier-key conventions (Kbd's os prop, shortcut hints, Command footers) or on a coarse pointer.
meta.whenNotToUse: Viewport-width layout switching — that is useIsMobile; and never wire it inside Kbd itself, which must stay server-safe.
